# openobserve_stream (Data Source)

Reads settings for an existing OpenObserve stream.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openobserve_stream" "default_logs" {
  org_id      = "default"
  name        = "default"
  stream_type = "logs"
}

output "default_logs_retention" {
  value = data.openobserve_stream.default_logs.settings.data_retention
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Stream name.
- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier.
- `stream_type` (String) Stream type: `logs`, `metrics`, or `traces`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source ID in the format `{org_id}/{stream_type}/{name}`.
- `settings` (Attributes) Stream-level settings as configured in OpenObserve. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))
- `storage_type` (String) Storage backend reported by OpenObserve (e.g. `s3`, `local`).

<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Read-Only:

- `bloom_filter_fields` (List of String) Fields with bloom filter acceleration.
- `data_retention` (Number) Days data is retained.
- `full_text_search_keys` (List of String) Fields included in full-text search.
- `index_fields` (List of String) Fields that are indexed.
- `partition_keys` (Attributes List) Partition keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--partition_keys))

<a id="nestedatt--settings--partition_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.partition_keys`

Read-Only:

- `field` (String)
- `types` (List of String)
